items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I did Tambourines to Glory with Langston.

ctx.x: No..mhm mhm. I had begged Langston...this was the forerunner of the Eubie and Don't Bother Me and all of that. I told Langston, "Langston, don't make this a play. Make it a musical." But I don't know if he had the say so, or if he was, you know, who had the rights to the book. But if they'd of made that a musical it would still be running. It would still been running. Because it was a good book.
I don't know if I told you about the Crawdaddy test .
